subtasks.title: Make newest Live Hit open details on list row and map marker (desktop + compact)
subtasks.approach: Root cause class: Hit Details opens under/behind competing top-left chrome, and/or the first list row loses clicks to the controls stack; newest-only symptom matches top-of-stack + optional null coords (no map pan cue). Fix: (1) collapse Live Hits whenever selectedHit is set (covers list + map marker paths); (2) raise Hit Details sheet above map chrome; (3) stop controls from stealing top-row clicks (republish height on toggle + safer offset + Live Hits z above controls while expanded); (4) key list rows by scan_id.
subtasks.intended_diffs: DashboardOverlay: key=scan_id; watch selectedHit→collapse live hits; z/offset safety. ScoutControlsWidget: republish --scout-controls-h on expand toggle. MapShell/BottomSheet: elevate sheet stacking; re-enter anim when selection changes while open.
